subject: Hybrid index gateway: partner gateway pilot + ecosystem onboarding
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@atlasdata.com>, Tom Novak <tom.novak@weaviate.com>, partners@pinecone.io
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid index gateway: partner gateway pilot + ecosystem onboarding

Hi Maya / Tom / Pinecone partners —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As discussed, we want to propose a short pilot to validate an "index gateway" pattern that: 1) serves vectors via a lightweight S3-backed chunkstore for cold content, 2) falls through to pgvector for medium-hot indexes, and 3) routes high-QPS queries to Pinecone/Weaviate depending on customer policy. The goal is to show predictable cost/latency tradeoffs and a simple path to production for ISVs and consultancies.

Attached is a 3-page proposal (hybrid-index-gateway-proposal.pdf) and an initial interop matrix. High-level asks: 
- Can AtlasData provide a sample S3-bucket + small catalog to run indexing (3M docs)?
- Pinecone/Weaviate: can your teams validate a routing test (100 RPS sustained, 512-token context) and share simple credentials for a sandbox?
- Redwood: we'll provide a minimal runtime harness and metrics dashboard.

Proposed timeline (2-week pilot):
1) Week 0: alignment + infra access
2) Week 1: ingest + baseline benchmarks
3) Week 2: routing experiments + cost/latency report

Can we lock a kickoff next week? I put a few proposed windows in the doc and included a short sign-off checklist.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Partner Manager, Alliances
Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: hybrid-index-gateway-proposal.pdf

From: Maya Singh <maya@atlasdata.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Novak <tom.novak@weaviate.com>, partners@pinecone.io
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hybrid index gateway: partner gateway pilot + ecosystem onboarding

Jasmine —

This looks promising. AtlasData can provision a small demo bucket and a 500k-document sample overnight; happy to scale to 3M if the pilot metrics look right. I'll loop in our solutions engineer (cc'd: Alex on my side, who'll follow up separately).

A couple quick questions:
- For the S3 chunkstore, what object-size distribution should we expect? (chunking at 4–16 KB typically)
- How do you expect auth to be managed for the temporary sandbox keys? We'll need to agree TTLs and rotation cadence.

We can do a kickoff on Monday or Tuesday next week — prefer mornings ET.

Best,
Maya
Head of Solutions, AtlasData
maya@atlasdata.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Singh <maya@atlasdata.com>, Tom Novak <tom.novak@weaviate.com>, partners@pinecone.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid index gateway: partner gateway pilot + ecosystem onboarding

All —

Thanks Maya. To answer a couple points inline:
- Chunk sizes: 8 KB nominal (we'll accept 4–16 KB). We have an ingestion shim that will re-chunk if needed; we'll share the code snippet in the runbook.
- Sandbox auth: Redwood prefers short-lived keys (1h) issued by a temporary token exchange. For AtlasData we can accept presigned S3 URLs for ingest if you prefer to avoid cross-account IAM for the pilot. For Pinecone/Weaviate we need API keys with a clear TTL (7 days max for the sandbox account).

I've uploaded an initial interop matrix and a small runbook snippet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDEF-playbook — the interop-matrix-v1.xlsx is attached to this thread. The matrix includes the routing policy variants we'll test (latency-first, cost-first, region-affinity).

Action items before kickoff: 
- Atlas: provision sample bucket + README with sample S3 object layout
- Pinecone / Weaviate: provide sandbox endpoints + test keys (7d TTL)
- Redwood (Ben/laura): baseline runtime image + monitoring (Prometheus + export to the Drive sheet)

I also want to confirm scope: this pilot validates routing and basic caching only — not enterprise-level replication or SLA work. If this goes well, we'll scope a deeper Dedicated offering pilot with longer retention and rollout controls.

-Vanessa
Director, Partner Product
Redwood Inference
Attachment: interop-matrix-v1.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Singh <maya@atlasdata.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid index gateway: partner gateway pilot + ecosystem onboarding

Quick note from the runtime side —
- I'll spin up a lightweight harness on g4dn-replacement nodes and pre-load a 100k subset for the baseline.
- Expect CPU-bound chunking step ~30s for 100k docs; KV cache warmup will take ~10 minutes for the 512-token tests.
- I'll include a small script (runbook-snippets.txt) that sets the batching and kv-cache params we'll use.

I can run the baseline Wednesday morning PT if the sandbox creds are ready.

—Ben
Senior SW Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Great momentum. Confirming the kickoff for Wed 2026-09-09 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET. Agenda: 15m alignment, 30m ingest + baseline plan, 15m routing scenarios & next steps. Calendar invite sent (link: https://meet.redwoodinference.com/kal/xyz-kickoff).

If anything blocks you before Wednesday ping me directly. Looking forward to it.

Jasmine Liu
